text: The Northgate Trust donates mobile libraries to mountain villages.
The Northgate Trust has responsibility for inspecting mountain villages.
The Northgate Trust photographed mountain villages for the annual report.
The Coastal Fund provides storm shelters to fishing towns.
The Coastal Fund has a duty to list fishing towns.
The Coastal Fund mentioned fishing towns in its newsletter.
The Crafts Guild awards tool grants to apprentice workshops.
The Crafts Guild has the right to visit apprentice workshops.
The Crafts Guild met apprentice workshops at the trade fair.
The Parks Service supplies water pumps to desert ranger stations.
The Parks Service has authority to close desert ranger stations.
The Parks Service mapped desert ranger stations during the survey.
The Harbor Commission transfers decommissioned buoys to sailing clubs.
The Harbor Commission has responsibility for rating sailing clubs.
The Harbor Commission discussed sailing clubs at the hearing.
The Medical Board gives training mannequins to rural clinics.
The Medical Board has the right to certify rural clinics.
The Medical Board visited rural clinics last spring.
